notes.title: New Game Mode: Savanna Here
notes.content:
[h1]New Game Mode: Savanna is Here! 🦒
[/h1]

Thanks to feedback from our players, we realized that the previous mode could go on for too long, creating a sense of "endless" gameplay. Based on your suggestions, we’ve created Savanna Mode, offering a more challenging experience!

In Savanna Mode:

A more limited play area,

The final animal no longer merges, making end-game strategy even more important!

[h2]General Improvements and New Features:

[/h2][h3]🦴 Adjusted Animal Hitboxes[/h3]
We’ve fine-tuned the hitboxes, especially for the animals in the Savanna. This means a more consistent and fair gameplay experience.

[h3]🎨 New UI Elements Added[/h3]
We’ve added some fresh touches to the game interface! Most notably, there’s now a special loop indicator exclusive to Safari Mode.

[h3]🧱 Updated Savanna Fences[/h3]
We redesigned the fences to better match the new environment. You’ll really feel the spirit of the Savanna now!

[h3]🛡️ Anti-Cheat Measures Implemented[/h3]
To protect your gameplay experience, we’ve added extra security measures to prevent cheating.

[h2]Bug Fixes:
[/h2]
[h3]🔐 Authentication Issue Resolved[/h3]
We’ve addressed problems with the login system and handled several potential errors. You can now enjoy a smoother experience.

notes.title: New Game Mode: Savanna Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]New Game Mode: Savanna Coming Soon!
[/h1]

Get ready for a brand-new experience: Savanna Mode is coming soon! In this exciting new mode, we’re taking you beyond the classic farm setting and into the heart of the wild—into the hot and arid lands of the savanna. New animals, a fresh atmosphere, and a faster-paced challenge await you.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/96efb7aac34403c4594c5f3f5e0370d00554bcaf.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/e4514b48c6faa0458ea1c8f8f4eb42df28fd83fc.png[/img][/url]
At the same time, we're working on balancing the pace and duration of the endless gameplay in Farm Mode to make it more enjoyable for everyone.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/0dba23e1e15d6b4f919d1df5030d81a99c8785f6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/534f6671e4b4014fa047de5587102f5a8531a567.png[/img][/url]
In Savanna Mode, our goal is to create a fun and competitive experience especially for players with limited time. That’s why this mode offers shorter, more intense sessions that demand both strategy and quick reflexes.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/79588e25d9ba07d46d301d54ebf5a08688385060.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/ae5d2f6aa71dc96c1b02e3e063bc6bb1be1d63cf.png[/img][/url]
Enjoy the new experience, and don’t forget to share your feedback with us!
See you soon! 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/9e41fae97723be3479c0659ad357d2cc315560f7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/e5ecfdd5e96114fd0e430e0341f80f7d5f4a0c36.png[/img][/url]
[h2]General Improvements and Innovations
[/h2]

Our previous font displayed some characters incorrectly and didn’t support others at all, so we’ve replaced it with a new one.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/0d2d5f86c27c2585bf939e8b92edf9e60d468bf7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/84d359642619d78d9b02d84144205adb6318e1b3.png[/img][/url]
Adjustments were made to the volume settings on the Supporter Claim screen.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/eb912074268340b2730e76224257bf9ce2e3743d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/f0c72d135de58807665ce69f603c5f003ec62dbb.png[/img][/url]
The algorithms behind the leaderboard have been updated and improved for better performance.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/6daa365c05ebfc3a1899c039ac1a4e0c3dcbddc3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/fd3d2e038e5ae389109f5bbf89a80f5a175a5b72.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🎉 A Release Full of UI Touches and Effects! 🎉
notes.content:
Our game is now officially live — you can play it right now!

[h2]🛠️ UI Fixes and Improvements
[/h2]We’ve gone through all the missing or buggy UI elements one by one. Everything is now cleaner and smoother! ✅
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/348170d38a99c7adab0c90275c2e88ff5797805c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/2821aa4e9546d8b7415121e50feddcc85afa6290.png[/img][/url]
[h2]✨ Smooth Panel Open-Close Effects
[/h2]Panels no longer pop in and out suddenly! We’ve added sweet animations for a better experience. 🧃
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/3e4a01a5c6f7001420e4656e05cb77e2ad98e804.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/784ed36877f334253e48359dd97a4bf8bd80a616.png[/img][/url]
[h2]🎞️ UI Animations
[/h2]We’ve added small but effective animations to various interface elements. 💫
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/79e0d8b3e1d7386164f356f4d9b4872418e31023.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/870e68b3537efb0ad31d39cf529953f7a783f743.png[/img][/url]
[h2]🌟 Effects for Supporter and Streamer Tag UIs
[/h2]Special effects have been added to the Supporter and Streamer Tags. 💖
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/a1234f07af00ca3ccd37100248112af257b076a0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/b404cfebe524fbddfb9372ba582f5c76d346b060.png[/img][/url]
[h2]🎁 Updated Supporter Tag Claim Screen
[/h2]We fixed a bug that occurred while claiming the Supporter Tag and added a new animation to the process. 🏷️⚡
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/7aae850dccc63887c83baebe9871cbdac5c5f6ed.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257011/1ff0cd59b8a2edf386985856082b040c3bcce958.png[/img][/url]
With all these changes, the UI is now more polished, both visually and in terms of user experience. We’re excited to hear your feedback! 🙌

notes.title: Code Overhaul Complete – Join Us on May 16!
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️General Improvements and Innovations:[/h2]

🧠We rewrote the game engine from scratch; we no longer use any part of the AI-generated code that was initially used for prototyping during the proof of concept phase.

🐾We reworked the hitboxes of all animals.

😉We reduced the frequency of the blinking animations.

🚧We extended the fences to make the game area more visually clear. This also increases the chance of bouncing animals off the fences like in billiards, giving you more strategic options.

[h2]🔊 Audio and Music Updates:[/h2]

🐷Added new sound effects for animal throwing and merging moments.

🐂A unique sound effect was added specifically for bull merging — and it’s a bit different than usual.

🎶We’ve added our own original game music.

📹If you’re creating content related to Cat and Farm Pals, you can freely use the game’s music without any licensing concerns.

[h2]🎮Gameplay Improvements:[/h2]

⚡We improved the animal merging algorithm: merging now occurs based on the faster-moving animal.

🧽We removed all old braking system info texts that used to remain on animals.

[h2]🐞Bug Fixes:
[/h2]
Fixed an authentication issue caused by Steam usernames.
